observations: Three photos show stacks of used car tires in a shop or storage area with tiled flooring.
Photo 0: Multiple tires stacked vertically, some with visible tread wear, others with intact tread. A watermark 'IKWE ANTHONY' is overlaid.
Photo 1: Similar stack of tires, some with red and blue markings on sidewalls. Tread appears worn in many cases.
Photo 2: Close-up of a tire stack showing tread pattern and sidewall. Tread is visibly worn, with deep grooves and missing sipes. No brand or model visible on sidewall.
No rims are visible in any photo.
No size or model markings are readable on any tire sidewall or tread in any photo.
The seller claims 'Belgium tires and rim', but no brand or origin is visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: No brand or origin visible on any tire in any photo. The claim cannot be verified from the images.

claims.claim: Tread is still 90 percent, no patch, no bulge. Removed from a 2023 car.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Tires may be damaged, cracked, or have hidden structural issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of tire sidewalls and treads from multiple angles, including under the tread and around the bead area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially unsafe or unusable, with reduced value.

risks.risk: Tires may be from a different brand or model than claimed, affecting compatibility and value.
risks.proof: Clear photos of tire sidewall markings showing brand, model, size, and year of manufacture.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used tires, with lower value due to uncertainty.

risks.risk: Tires may be expired or have been used beyond safe limits, affecting safety and resale value.
risks.proof: Photos of tire sidewall showing DOT code (e.g., 5-digit code indicating year and week of manufacture).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used tires with unknown age, with reduced value.

proof_requests: Clear photos of tire sidewalls showing brand, model, size, and DOT code.
Close-up shots of tire treads from multiple angles, including under the tread and around the bead area.
Photos of any rims included with the tires, if any.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
